assignment.title: Reviewing a pull request
assignment.instructions:
Review the practice pull request in the scenario pack and hand in your review. It must contain:
- at least three specific comments, each with a line reference
- one comment on security
- a summary recommendation: approve or request changes

sections.heading: Summary of the change
paragraphs: The pull request adds a function that returns the most recent borrowing records for a library member and wires it into the member page. I read the diff of the three changed files: members.py, borrowing.py and the template member.html.

sections.heading: Comments
paragraphs: borrowing.py, line 18: the loop variable is called x, which makes the next ten lines hard to follow. Please rename it to record.
borrowing.py, line 27: the page size 10 appears here and again on line 41. Please move it into one named constant so the two cannot drift apart.
members.py, line 64: the function returns the list sorted oldest first, but the member page shows the heading Most recent. It should sort newest first, or the heading should change.
member.html, line 12: the empty state is a blank space. A short message such as No borrowing yet would be kinder to a new member.

sections.heading: Recommendation
paragraphs: Request changes. The sort order on members.py line 64 shows the wrong records under the Most recent heading, and the two naming and constant issues are quick to fix at the same time.
